privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.storedBody: Your profile, checklist progress, matches, chats and reports are stored only on this device. There is no account and no server.
privacy.sharedBody: Matches see your display name and the fields you leave visible. Hidden fields are never shown or used for matching.
privacy.contactBody: No phone number, email or exact address is shown to anyone until you both agree.
privacy.aiBody: AI features are off unless you turn them on in Privacy choices. When one is on, only the text you choose to use with it is sent, through our server, to Google Gemini. Never your name, contact details or chat history. AI answers can be wrong, and you always decide.
privacy.deleteConfirmBody: This removes your profile, progress, chats and reports from this device. It cannot be undone.
privacy.deleted: All your data has been deleted.

consent.title: Privacy choices
consent.subtitle: Everything here is off until you turn it on. You can change your mind at any time.
consent.analyticsBody: Share anonymous usage data to help us improve the app. No names, messages or contact details.
consent.notificationsBody: Allow NEXTORA to send you notifications. Notification text never includes message content.
consent.aiProvider: AI features are run by Google Gemini on our server. Only the text you choose to use with a feature is sent: never your name, contact details or chat history.
consent.aiUnavailable: AI features are not available yet
consent.aiTranslateBody: Translate posts and messages into your language. The original always stays visible.
consent.aiAssistBody: Suggestions such as a clearer title. Nothing is posted without you.
consent.aiAssistantBody: Answers drawn only from content our team has checked, with a link to the source.
consent.aiVoiceBody: Your recording is sent once to Google Gemini through our server to turn it into text, then discarded. You check and edit the words before sending.
